The person who watches superhero must be immediately to the right of the person who listens to classical. With only two positions, this forces the classical listener to be in position 1 and the superhero watcher in position 2.  
Since each attribute value is unique across the two people, position 1 must have the opposite movie‑genre (spy) and position 2 the opposite music‑genre (pop).  
The statement “the person who listens to pop is not the same as the person who drinks cola” means the pop listener (position 2) cannot drink cola, so position 2 drinks mirinda and position 1 drinks cola.  

Thus:
- The mirinda drinker (position 2) watches **superhero**.  
- The mirinda drinker is at position **2**.  
- The classical listener (position 1) watches **spy**.  
- The cola drinker (position 1) listens to **classical**.

<solution>superhero, 2, spy, classical</solution>
Final answer: superhero, 2, spy, classical
